llm.summary: This skill drafts student progress reports using disclosed, narrowly scoped records and keeps teachers in control of saving evidence and sharing reports.

dimensions.detail: Access includes months of sensitive student records and parent communication summaries, but this is explicitly disclosed and limited to the selected student.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown and JSON, with no executable payload, remote installer, or credential requirement. Companion skills are declared separately.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Requires one named student before access, limits reads to relevant fields, checks sharing consent, and requires teacher confirmation before saving progress evidence.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistence is limited to confirmed progress evidence, with view, correction, export, pause, and confirmed deletion controls. Whole-student retention and deletion use a separate archive workflow; no background persistence is requested.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Reading learning history and lesson balances fits the reporting purpose; the skill prohibits editing balances, changing student status, or sending reports.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Use authorized student records, check consent settings, and review reports before sharing them. Confirm that your host platform enforces the stated access limits and supports the separate archive-deletion workflow. SECURITY_BASELINE.md is referenced but absent; the main privacy restrictions are also stated directly in the bundled instructions.
llm.findings: [AE1] expected: All three advisory entries concern ordinary references to shared/vocab.md. Full inspection found reporting definitions and consent rules; the reported parser span limit does not establish evasion.
